minlen.description: Minimum total length required for new passwords.

minlower.description: Minimum number of lowercase letters (a–z) required.

minupper.description: Minimum number of uppercase letters (A–Z) required.

mindigits.description: Minimum number of digit characters (0–9) required.

minother.description: Minimum number of non-alphanumeric characters (e.g., !, @, #) required.

maxrepeat.description: Maximum number of identical consecutive characters allowed (e.g., 'aaa' = 3 repeats).

maxclassrepeat.description: Maximum number of consecutive characters from the same class (e.g., 'abcd' = 4 letters).

dictcheck.description: Enable or disable dictionary-based rejection of easily guessable passwords.

dictpath.description: Custom path to dictionary file (e.g., /usr/share/dict/cracklib-passwords). Leave empty to use the default system dictionary.

usercheck.description: Reject passwords that contain the username (case-insensitive).

revusercheck.description: Reject passwords that contain the reverse of the username (requires usercheck=true to be effective).

similarity.description: Maximum allowed similarity (0–100) to the old password (e.g., 50 = ≤50% similar). Set to 0 to disable similarity check.

enforce_for_root.description: Apply the same password rules to the root user (otherwise root may use weaker passwords).

oldcheck.description: Reject passwords identical to or reversed from the previous password.

remember.description: Number of previous passwords to remember (for oldcheck). Set to 0 to disable history.

gecoscheck.description: Reject passwords containing any GECOS field (full name, office, phone, etc.).

debug.description: Enable verbose logging to syslog for troubleshooting (auth facility).

strict.description: Enforce that all character classes (lower, upper, digit, other) must be present, regardless of min* settings.

extra_configs.description: Optional additional configuration file paths for site-specific rules (e.g., /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/local.conf). Each must be a valid pwquality.conf-style file.

items.description: Absolute path to an additional pwquality configuration file.
